Subject: Draft: FirstLight usage case — fact-check & quote approval

Hi Helen —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Attached is the first draft of the case write-up we discussed: "FirstLight & Redwood — reducing inference cost for nightly batch workloads." Please review the sections called "Savings by quarter" and "Deployment footprint" — those include the usage numbers we pulled from your team (Q1–Q2).

What we need from you for publication:
- Quick fact-check of the usage numbers and dates in the Savings table.
- Confirmation that the customer quote on page 2 is ok to publish (we've marked it in bold).
- Any legal/brand requirements or redlines to the customer name/logo usage.

I've also added an editable Doc (link below) for inline comments. If possible, can you send edits by EOD Friday so we can keep this in the August customer spotlight?

Attachments: firstlight-case-draft-v1.docx (docx), firstlight-supporting-figures.xlsx (xlsx)
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2b3C4d_firstlight-case-draft

Thanks — appreciate it.

—Jordan

Subject: Re: Draft: FirstLight usage case — fact-check & quote approval

Jordan —

Thanks for the draft and the clear checklist. We reviewed internally and I left inline comments in the Drive doc. High-level notes here:

- Numbers: The Q1 usage in the table is off by ~6% — our final billed tokens for Jan–Mar were 1.06M (not 1.12M). I attached the reconciliation sheet (see firstlight-supporting-figures.xlsx).
- Deployment footprint: Please remove the on-prem reference on page 3. We used the Redwood Private preview internally but haven't publicized that deployment with customers.
- Quote: I can provide an updated short quote: "Redwood's runtime cut our per-token latency by half and made nightly processing predictable — enabling the team to ship earlier." Happy to sign off on that wording.
- Legal/brand: Our legal team asks that the FirstLight logo be low-res for the preview and that any final logo files come from our brand kit.

Looping in our internal legal reviewer (cc'd here) for any final language checks. I can get the final confirmation by Monday.

Best,
Helen
Helen Park
Head of Data Products | FirstLight, Inc.
helen.park@firstlight.ai

Hi Helen —

Appreciate the quick review and the suggested quote — that wording reads great. We've pulled the Q1 numbers down to 1.06M based on your sheet and removed the on-prem mention.

Ben — can you take a quick look at the proposed quote and our standard publication paragraph? Also confirming we will only use the low-res logo for the preview; we'll pull the final artworks from FirstLight's brand kit once Helen's legal gives the ok.

Marissa — once Ben signs off, can you push the final version to the marketing queue? We want the short social blurb and the 1-page pdf condensed for the August newsletter.

I'll hold on publication until Helen's legal confirms next week.

Thanks,
Jordan

Jordan / Marissa —

Skimmed the quote and the public paragraph. A couple small suggestions:
- Replace "nightly processing" with "nightly jobs" to avoid implying batch-only usage.
- Add a one-sentence attribution line: "— Helen Park, Head of Data Products, FirstLight" (this helps downstream PR).
- Legal redline: we need explicit written approval to use the FirstLight logo and the exact quote in any promotional materials. Suggest we send a one-paragraph approval form via DocuSign after Helen confirms the quote.

If you want, I can draft the DocuSign approval and the short publication paragraph. Otherwise, I approve once the minor wording tweak is made and we receive the signed approval.

—Ben
